item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NLPRSD
Issued at 02:52 AM 17 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cagayan(Peñablanca, Baggao, Pamplona and SanchezMira) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
